source:
@@U00442@@
Shatter this world first, turn it into rubble, and then let the other world come. This is the earth my joys well out of; this is the sun shines down on my sorrows. Part me from them and what will may take its course. What happens happens. Let there be love and hate in those other spheres, let there be top and bottom, it means nothing to me.

@@U00444@@
With an attitude like that you can risk anything. Be bold! Bind yourself to me! Begin a new life! Youll see soon enough what I can do! You'll see spectacles no man has ever seen!

@@U00446@@
What, poor devil, what, what can you show me? Was the mind of man in its exalted striving ever grasped by the likes of you? What is it you offer? Food that gives no satisfaction? Red gold that runs like quicksilver through my fingers? A game no one can win? A girl who, while I’m lying in her arms, has already, with a wink, chosen another? Or honor worthy of the gods, that flares and is gone like a shooting star? All these things you have and what are they worth? Fruit that rots before it’s picked! Trees that shed their leaves and grow new ones daily!

@@U00448@@
What you ask is no great task for a devil. Such treasures are for the taking. And yet, my friend, the time will come when we'll choose to enjoy something special in peace and tranquility.
translation:
@@U00442@@
先把这个世界打碎，化为废墟，然后再让另一个世界到来。这就是我快乐的大地；这是阳光照耀着我的悲伤。将我与他们分开，一切都会顺其自然。发生什么就发生什么。其他领域有爱有恨，有上有下，对我来说毫无意义。

@@U00444@@
有了这样的态度，你可以冒任何风险。大胆点！把你自己束缚在我身边吧！开始新的生活！你很快就会看到我能做什么！你会看到人类从未见过的奇观！

@@U00446@@
什么，可怜的魔鬼，什么，你能给我看什么？人类崇高的奋斗精神是否曾被你们这样的人所领会？你提供什么？食物没有满足感？像水银一样流过我手指的红金？一场没有人能赢的游戏？当我躺在她怀里的时候，一个女孩已经眨了眨眼，选择了另一个？还是值得诸神的荣耀，像流星一样闪耀又消失？你拥有的所有这些东西，它们值多少钱？水果在采摘前就已经腐烂了！树木每天都会落叶并长出新叶！

@@U00448@@
对于魔鬼来说，你所要求的并不是什么伟大的任务。这样的宝藏是可以拿走的。然而，我的朋友，总有一天我们会选择在和平与安宁中享受一些特别的东西。
